thread:
erin: Postmortem follow-up for the repeated paging pattern we saw last week. Goal: assign remediation owners, lock a gating checklist before alerts are changed, and ensure we don't regress. I made a short tracker: https://go.redwood/pm-gate-alerts. Please claim by EOD.

sam: I'll take ownership of the consumer-facing API thresholds. Proposal: move to p95-based triggers, add a `for: 5m` sustain, and create a `notice` tier that doesn't page. I'll add a PR with diffs + rollback snippet. ETA Tue COB.

diego: I'll own dedupe + suppression. Plan: add `dedupe_key=resource_hash` and an adaptive suppression window that starts small (5m) but increases if the same key fires repeatedly. Will produce a small simulation harness against 14d history.

sara: We should gate changes behind this checklist: 1) owners claimed in tracker 2) historical trigger comparison (7/14/30d) included in PR 3) suppression simulation results posted 4) canary plan for single region (12h) + dashboard panel 5) runbook blurb for oncall. No change merged until all items green.

sam: Draft rule snippet I'm testing in staging:
```
alert: api_req_p95_high
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > 0.6
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: notice
  owner: sam
annotations:
  summary: "API p95 high for {{ $labels.route }}"
```
I'll include a `severity: page` variant for the tighter threshold in the PR for canary.

diego: For dedupe I'll start with exact key mapping: `resource_id -> resource_hash` and regex normalization: `s/^user:\d+:session:.+$/user:session/`. If noise remains we'll try probabilistic sketches. I'll add the harness and attach results to the tracker.

sara: Canary plan: enable in eu-west-1 for 12h, monitor `pages/hour`, `alerts->tickets` ratio, and synthetic failover detection. If pages drop >60% and synthetic detection unchanged, promote regionally.

ops-bot: Task created: PM-4805 "Gate and tune api_req_p95_high" assigned to @sam and @diego, due 2026-04-14.

erin: Please post PR links and the historical comparison queries here. We'll review checklist in Friday retro and only merge after canary shows no missed-detects. Also tagging security: if rules touch any auth metrics ping them.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/alerts/pull/501 3 contains rule diffs, comparison queries, and rollback snippet.

diego: Simulation results uploaded to the tracker (14d). Early look: suppression at 5m reduces pages by ~48% for the test set, conservative so far. I'll iterate if we see missed detections in canary.

erin: Thanks all 3 I'll mark PM ticket PM-4805 with owner assignments and checklist. If anyone can't hit ETA mark blocked in tracker. We'll do a 10m sync before canary begins. :white_check_mark:
